goal: See experimental probability (from repeated coin flips) wobble around but gradually settle near the theoretical probability of 0.5 as the number of flips grows.
brief: A coin-flip simulator with a running bar chart showing the percentage of heads so far, starting at 0 flips. A dashed horizontal line marks the theoretical value 0.5 (50%). Flipping updates the percentage live.

controls.label: Flip once
controls.effect: Adds one random flip and updates the running percentage of heads.

controls.label: Flip 50 at once
controls.effect: Adds 50 random flips at once, showing how quickly the line stabilizes near 50%.

controls.label: Reset
controls.effect: Clears all flips and starts the experiment over from 0.

try_this: Flip just 5 times and see how far the percentage can be from 50%.
Flip 50 at once and watch the percentage move closer to the dashed 50% line.
Reset and try again — does it look different early on but similar after many flips?
